subject: Quarter kickoff — Goal prioritization, risk buckets, and QBR runway
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara.tucker@acme.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter kickoff — Goal prioritization, risk buckets, and QBR runway

Team — kicking off the quarter planning loop. Aim: come out of this week with a prioritized list of owner-level objectives, a compact risk register (3 top risk buckets with mitigations), and a QBR runbook that covers exec readout + appendix artifacts.

Quick asks for today:
- Kimberly: can you propose the consolidated prioritization rubric (impact x confidence) by 11am PT? I want owners to use the same scoring language.
- Grace: pull last quarter's signal-to-noise on metrics; we'll want to retire 1-2 vanity metrics.
- Karthik: confirm stakeholder availability for the QBR rehearsal sessions next Wed/Thu and own the runbook timeline.

I've attached a working register (Q3_goal_risk_register.xlsx) and a first-pass runbook (QBR_runbook_v1.2.pdf). Please update the register with owner names and 1-line mitigation notes by EOD.

Agenda for the sync (30m):
1) Quick owner rollcall (5m)
2) Prioritization rubric & examples (10m)
3) Risk buckets and mitigations (10m)
4) Rehearsal timeline + runbook gaps (5m)

If we can get the rubric and a cleaned metric slate by noon, I'll send owners the official kickoff email and calendar invites.

Thanks —
Jonas
VP, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara.tucker@acme.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff — Goal prioritization, risk buckets, and QBR runway

Jonas — noted. Attached a short rubric doc (embedded in the register rows) and two scoring examples: one for a platform cost reduction objective and one for a latency SLO objective.

Key clarifications:
- Impact bands: Customer-facing revenue/retention, Platform unit cost, Developer velocity. Use consistent weightings (0.5/0.3/0.2) unless an owner argues for reweighting.
- Confidence: baseline = measurement availability + experiment plan. If confidence < 40%, recommend a discovery sprint instead of a committed metric.

I pre-populated owners for the platform and runtime buckets. Will finish owners for Benchmarking and QBR artifacts by 4pm PT.

Attachment: Q3_goal_risk_register.xlsx (updated tab "rubric_examples")

-Kim
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff — Goal prioritization, risk buckets, and QBR runway

Thanks — I ran the metrics slate overnight and flagged 5 metrics that have low signal (high variance, instrumentation gaps). I dropped two that are purely vanity and collapsed three related latency metrics into a single P95 latency with error budget.

Notes inline in the register. My recommended top risk buckets:
1) Model regression risk (test coverage + canary policy)
2) Cost pressure (GPU hours + caching miss rates)
3) Customer SLAs (regional failover + routing policy)

For each bucket I added 2 mitigations and an owner suggestion.

I'll be on the 2pm stakeholder call and can present the metric retirement rationale.

-Grace
Head of Analytics & Observability
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara.tucker@acme.com, ops@cloudbridge.io
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff — Goal prioritization, risk buckets, and QBR runway

Quick update after the stakeholder call: Acme's leadership asked us to add a short appendix in the QBR that highlights capacity and burst plan (they're evaluating Dedicated). I've added an "Customer asks" section to the runbook and flagged a cloud marketplace slide for the exec deck.

Action items updated in the shared runbook:
- Karthik: please coordinate with CloudBridge on the marketplace integration blurb and confirm a speaker for the QBR (deadline: Tue 6/22 EOD).
- Kim: finalize rubric and owners; I need the finalized register by 6/15 5pm PT so I can lock the rehearsal schedule.
- Grace: please add the metric variance charts to the appendix (two slides).

Link: QBR runbook (internal): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1QBR-Runbook-V1-2

Jonas

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara.tucker@acme.com, ops@cloudbridge.io
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff — Goal prioritization, risk buckets, and QBR runway

Acknowledged — I'll own the runbook timeline and the CloudBridge coordination. Confirmed rehearsal slots on Wed 6/23 10:00-11:30 and Thu 6/24 13:00-15:00 PT; sending calendar invites now.

I'll also add a short "FAQ for execs" one-pager to the runbook covering: why we retired metrics, what an owner commitment means, and fallback plans for model regressions. Expect the updated runbook and the FAQ by EOD 6/18.

-Karthik
VP, Platform Programs
Redwood Inference
